stories.title: Led by MVP Williams, Valkyries outlast Dream, secure first WNBA title
stories.summary: Gabby Williams scored 30 points and was named Finals MVP after leading the Valkyries to their first WNBA title with a 68-63 Game 7 victory over the Dream.

stories.title: Irish rally to open season with win over Villanova in Rome
stories.summary: Notre Dame rallied late to beat Villanova in the Eternal City Tip-Off, a season opening event played in Rome in front of Wildcats alum Pope Leo XIV.

stories.title: Embattled Riley relishes win as USC saves CFP hopes with upset of Ohio State
stories.summary: USC kept its CFP hopes alive with a 30-18 upset of No. 2 Ohio State as coach Lincoln Riley delivered an emphatic victory amid questions surrounding his future.

stories.title: Big 12 admits replay review got it wrong in awarding BYU first-quarter TD
stories.summary: The Big 12 acknowledged an officiating error in No. 8 BYU's 27-20 win over Arizona State that incorrectly awarded the Cougars a first-quarter touchdown.

stories.title: Sources: Saquon won't be traded before deadline despite Eagles' struggles
stories.summary: Saquon Barkley will not be traded before the trade deadline, sources told NFL Network, putting an end to speculation that the Eagles RB could be on the move.
